sect1.title: DESCRIPTION
sect1.para: This BpSecBundleProcessor static class defines the methods for adding and processing BCB confidentiality and BIB integrity blocks based on the security policy Rules. It also includes the implementation of the cryptographic functions using OpenSSL APIs.
